verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's first-party product pages say the keys log in to websites using 'secure One Time Passwords (OTP)'. The Nitrokey 3 listing names one-time passwords among its combined features, and the docs feature index has a Two Factor Authentication section. This covers the core of the legacy-OTP story, but only through marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of TOTP vs HOTP support, slot counts or storage capacity, challenge-response mode, in-depth setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that OTP works.
